UNTILED-CALOTECH completed, read-only, at `b9f5af38520ea83215587757b02cd090adc8fb8a`.

Recommended continuous slabs:

- Barrel: each layer at radial \(x=1702.5+10.9l\) mm, thickness 0.5 mm, \(|z|\le3900\) mm, \(|y|\le x\tan(\pi/16)-1\) mm.
- Endcaps: local slab plane \(z=2.5+10.9l\) mm, thickness 0.5 mm, carrier polygon \(100\le x\le2223.2\) mm, \(|y|\le x\tan(\pi/16)-1\) mm; retain existing negative-end rotations.
- Preserve the inherited 1 mm half-seam, beam aperture, W, cooling, electronics, wafer films and other passives. Replace only active/guard wafer silicon. Subtract slab intersections from barrel rails/slab-end frames and the endcap supported frame.

Exact carrier wedges require sloped cuts through the barrel wafer thickness. I supplied SoftEng an XML-only construction using a rectangular wafer plus rotated extruded-polygon cutters, preserving tangent/axial readout coordinates.

Independent analytic full sensitive-volume targets:

| Region | Original active Si (mm³) | Original guard Si (mm³) | Full sensitive slab (mm³) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Barrel | 1,393,548,288 | 64,062,912 | 2,327,867,693.009 |
| Both endcaps | 523,441,593.484 | 34,119,836.730 | 750,268,701.311 |

Additional wafer silicon is **1,062,963,764.106 mm³**, approximately **2.476 tonnes** at the retained density. Guard silicon also becomes sensitive.

This measures the effect of replacing tiled active coverage with continuous silicon, including added material and necessary aluminium replacement at silicon planes. It cannot isolate electronics or virtual readout segmentation effects; no such response model is present.

Evidence: pinned `barrel_export.py` lines 33–52, `edge_export.py` lines 39–80, factory shape/placement logic, DES-030/031, and retained compact/material XML. Checks used XML parsing, polygon-area calculations and replica multiplicities. No native overlap or transport checks performed; no files changed.

limitations: Only userMessage and agentMessage text retained; reasoning, tool arguments/results and private state excluded.
Conservative path, credential, email and URL redaction is not a privacy guarantee; review retained text.
Exposed operation counts are per retained turn; journal counts can describe the same invocations and must not be added.
Only started subagent activities establish child relationships; send/wait/completion activities remain operation counts and do not imply parenthood.
